description: At the Punta del Sebo in Huelva after dark, the colossal cubist Columbus monument towers above the river confluence. Its angular stone mass is a dark giant against the night sky, the Odiel and Tinto rivers merging black and silent below. The monument looms over the water, alone in the night stillness.
